arxiv-2205-12368.title: Medical Scientific Table-to-Text Generation with Human-in-the-Loop under the Data Sparsity Constraint
arxiv-2205-12368.creator: Heng-Yi Wu, Jingqing Zhang, Julia Ive, Tong Li, Vibhor Gupta, Bingyuan Chen, Yike Guo
arxiv-2205-12368.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Heng-Yi Wu, Jingqing Zhang, Julia Ive, Tong Li, Vibhor Gupta, Bingyuan Chen, Yike Guo. Structured (tabular) data in the preclinical and clinical domains contains valuable information about individuals and an efficient table-to-text summarization system can drastically reduce manual efforts to condense this data into reports. However, in practice, the problem is heavily impeded by the data paucity, data sparsity and inability of the state-of-the-art natural language generation models (including T5, PEGASUS and GPT-Neo) to produce accurate and reliable outputs.

arxiv-2209-06581.title: Applying wav2vec2 for Speech Recognition on Bengali Common Voices Dataset
arxiv-2209-06581.creator: 1 st H.A.Z Sameen Shahgir, 2 nd Khondker Salman Sayeed, 3 rd Tanjeem Azwad Zaman
arxiv-2209-06581.description: Abstract Speech is inherently continuous, where discrete words, phonemes and other units are not clearly segmented, and so speech recognition has been an active research problem for decades. In this work we have fine-tuned wav2vec 2.0 to recognize and transcribe Bengali speech – training it on the Bengali Common Voice Speech Dataset .

arxiv-2210-12362.title: EnDex : Evaluation of Dialogue Engagingness at Scale
arxiv-2210-12362.creator: Guangxuan Xu, Ruibo Liu, Fabrice Harel-Canada, Nischal Reddy Chandra, Nanyun Peng
arxiv-2210-12362.description: Abstract We propose EnDex , the first human-reaction based model to evaluate dialogue engagingness. EnDex is trained on 80k Reddit-based Engagement Dataset (RED) curated using a novel distant-supervision framework. Engagingness is a key measure that captures high-level quality of AI dialogue systems and closely reflects actual user experience.

arxiv-2212-03054.title: DisTRaC: Accelerating High Performance Compute Processing for Temporary Data Storage
arxiv-2212-03054.creator: Gabryel Mason-Williams, Dave Bond, and Mark Basham
arxiv-2212-03054.description: Abstract High Performance Compute (HPC) clusters often produce intermediate files as part of code execution and message passing is not always possible to supply data to these cluster jobs. In these cases, I/O goes back to central distributed storage to allow cross node data sharing.

arxiv-2307-13074.title: Constraints on Tidal Quality Factor in Kepler Eclipsing Binaries using Tidal Synchronization: A Frequency-Dependent Approach 2022 Constraints on Tidal Quality Factor in Kepler Eclipsing Binaries using Tidal Synchronization: A Frequency-Dependent Approach – A
arxiv-2307-13074.creator: Ruskin Patel, Kaloyan Penev, Joshua Schussler
arxiv-2307-13074.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ruskin Patel, Kaloyan Penev, Joshua Schussler. Tidal dissipation in binary systems is the primary source for synchronization and circularization of the objects in the system. The efficiency of the dissipation of tidal energy inside stars or planets results in significant changes in observed properties of the binary system and is often studied empirically using a parameter, commonly known as the modified tidal quality factor ( Q ⋆ ′ {Q_{\star}^{\prime}} ).

arxiv-2503-10864.title: Solid-State Gravitational Redshift: Transport Signatures of Massless Dirac Fermions in Tilted Dirac Cone Heterostructures
arxiv-2503-10864.creator: Marziyeh Karmand, Mohsen Amini, Morteza Soltani, Ebrahim Ghanbari-Adivi, Seyed Akbar Jafari
arxiv-2503-10864.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marziyeh Karmand, Mohsen Amini, Morteza Soltani, Ebrahim Ghanbari-Adivi, Seyed Akbar Jafari. We investigate the propagation of electron waves in a two-dimensional tilted Dirac cone heterostructure where tilt depends on the coordinate z z along the junction. The resulting Dirac equation in an emergent curved spacetime for the spinor ψ ⁡ ( z ) \psi(z) can be efficiently solved using 4th-order Runge-Kutta numerical method by a transformation to a ”suitable” spinor φ \varphi where the resulting Dirac cone looks locally upright.

arxiv-2508-10078.title: On Proximity and other Distance Parameters in Planar Graphs
arxiv-2508-10078.creator: Peter Dankelmann, Sonwabile Mafunda, Sufiyan Mallu
arxiv-2508-10078.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Peter Dankelmann, Sonwabile Mafunda, Sufiyan Mallu. Let G G be a connected graph. The average distance of a vertex v v of G G is the arithmetic mean of the distances from v v to all other vertices of G G . The proximity and remoteness of G G are defined as the minimum and maximum, respectively, of the average distances of the vertices of G G .

arxiv-2509-26250.title: On the finiteness of logarithmic Hamiltonians for Volterra-type lattices in terms of the spectral measures of Jacobi operators
arxiv-2509-26250.creator: Andrey Osipov
arxiv-2509-26250.description: Abstract We establish a correspondence between the semi-infinite and infinite Volterra lattices having a finite logarithmic Hamiltonian and certain classes of even probability measures. In doing so, we apply the inverse spectral theory of Jacobi operators and the theory of orthogonal polynomials. A similar correspondence is established for semi-infinite modified Volterra lattices. Keywords and phrases.

arxiv-2601-13011.title: Topological Charges, Fermi Arcs, and Surface States of K 4 K_{4} Crystal
arxiv-2601-13011.creator: Shoya Yoshida, Katsuhiro Takahashi, Katsunori Wakabayashi
arxiv-2601-13011.description: Abstract We investigate the topological electronic properties of the K 4 K_{4} crystal by constructing a tight-binding model. The bulk band structure hosts Weyl nodes with higher and conventional chiralities ( χ = ± 2 \chi=\pm 2 and χ = ± 1 \chi=\pm 1 ) located at high-symmetry points in the Brillouin zone.

pmc-11713092.title: Improvements in Usability of MoCA XpressO, a Self‐administered Digital Cognitive Pre‐screening Tool
pmc-11713092.creator: Johanna Gruber, Katie Bodenstein, Richard Jansen, Marion Paquette‐Masson, Joana Krieger, Murray Gillies, Ziad Nasreddine
pmc-11713092.description: BackgroundXpressO from Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) is a self‐administered, digital cognitive screening test composed of memory and executive function tasks. Its purpose is to provide a brief pre‐screening of cognition in order to determine whether further cognitive testing is required. A previous validation study comparing the XpressO to the gold standard MoCA test revealed a strong predictive value.

pmc-12430783.title: PLA/PBS Biocomposites for 3D FDM Manufacturing: Effect of Hemp Shive Content and Process Parameters on Printing Quality and Performances
pmc-12430783.creator: Emilia Garofalo, Luciano Di Maio, Loredana Incarnato
pmc-12430783.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study investigates the processability—via Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) 3D printing—and mechanical performance of biocomposites based on polylactic acid (PLA), polybutylene succinate (PBS), and their 50/50 wt% blend, each reinforced with hemp shive at 3 and 5 wt%. Blending PLA with PBS represents a straightforward and encouraging strategy to enhance both the printability and mechanical properties of the individual resins, expanding the range of their potential applications.

pmc-12547751.title: Engineering Two-in-One Nanoparticles for Simultaneous Delivery of Graphene Quantum Dot and Pemetrexed
pmc-12547751.creator: Umut Can Öz, Berrin Küçüktürkmen, I. Jénnifer Gómez, Amr Elsherbeny, Seda Ipek Tekneci, Özgür Eşim, Selin Göksever, Umut Uğur Özköse, Sevgi Gülyüz, Claudia Bazán-Cobelo, Özgür Yılmaz, Aylin Üstündağ, Jiřina Medalová, Asuman Bozkır, Lenka Zajíčková, Engin Er
pmc-12547751.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The simultaneous delivery of therapeutic agents and imaging probes using polymeric nanoparticles (NPs) has gained significant attention for cancer treatment. In this work, we developed a multifunctional nanocarrier system composed of an amphiphilic block copolymer, poly­(2-ethyl-2-oxazoline)-b-poly­(ε-caprolactone) (PEtOx-b-PCL), and dimethyldidodecylammonium bromide (DDAB), for the codelivery of the chemotherapeutic drug pemetrexed (PMT) and nitrogen- or sulfur-doped graphene quantum dots (N-GQDs or S-GQDs) as fluorescent probes. Critical formulation parameters were optimized using a central composite design (CCD).

pmc-12752364.title: Remimazolam tosylate vs. propofol: effects on anesthetic efficacy and renal function in living donor kidney transplantation
pmc-12752364.creator: Jiaxin Wu, Wendong Lin, Haiying Kong
pmc-12752364.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundRemimazolam Tosylate (RT) is an ultrashort-acting benzodiazepine with organ-independent metabolism, suitable for patients with renal impairment. This study assessed the efficacy and safety of RT in living donor kidney transplantation.MethodsEighty-six patients with uremia who underwent living donor kidney transplantation from May 2024 to October 2024 were randomized into the RT group (group RT) or the propofol group (group P), with 43 patients per group.

pmc-13571412.title: Transhepatic venous access as a vessel-preserving salvage strategy for temporary hemodialysis in venous access exhaustion
pmc-13571412.creator: Chun Kit Richard Chan, Chung Wai Wong, Hong Ching Lee, Ping Yung Chu, San Ming Yu
pmc-13571412.description: Patients with end-stage renal failure may develop progressively limited venous access for hemodialysis, particularly after repeated catheterization, thrombosis, and central venous stenosis. This may be especially problematic when temporary dialysis access is required while a permanent arteriovenous fistula is still maturing.

pmc-13624950.title: Cesarean Myomectomy: A Retrospective Observational Study at a Tertiary Care Center in Bihar, India
pmc-13624950.creator: Poonam Lal, Deeptimayee Pathi, Swaroop R Nanda
pmc-13624950.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionFibroids during pregnancy are frequently encountered in our routine obstetric practice. Whether cesarean myomectomy is a safe and practical treatment for women with uterine myomas or if it is completely contraindicated is a topic of much discussion. Due to the apprehension of increased blood loss, there remains a dilemma in obstetricians' decisions on whether to do a cesarean myomectomy or not.
